usage.result_excerpt:
`main.wj` is written. It compiles with `wj build` and gave the right output on my test run.

I ran it with `wj run --compiled` on the first three examples, `10 - 4 - 3`, and some invalid lines. The lines were `(1`, `1 2`, `3 +`, `()` and `2 $ 3`, plus one blank line. The valid expressions gave the postfix forms from your examples. All five invalid lines printed `error`, and the blank line was skip
